title: A Woman Who Fears the Lord Is to Be Praised
description: In this sermon, the preacher uses a personal anecdote to illustrate the fear of God. He describes a situation where a dog chases after someone who runs away from it, comparing it to how God pursues those who run away from Him. The preacher then shifts the focus to the importance of cherishing loved ones and not taking them for granted. He emphasizes the need to be grateful and to focus on the positive aspects of life rather than being critical. Finally, the preacher discusses the significance of praising women who fear the Lord, stating that it not only feels good but also honors God.
